title: Ingo Swann's thermistor experiments at City College
summary: Hal Puthoff tells of Ingo Swann's thermistor experiments at City College, about early 1970s at City College, New York, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: had done experiments at city college in new york under professor gertrude schmeider she had set up thermistors and from across the room he could make the temperatures go up and down

plain: Hal Puthoff, a scientist described as a CIA UFO expert, says that in the early 1970s the psychic Ingo Swann took part in experiments at City College in New York under a professor named Gertrude Schmeidler. According to Puthoff, she set up thermistors, small temperature sensors, and Swann could make their readings go up and down from across the room. If true, a human mind could affect physical objects at a distance.
